text.en: Cauda equina syndrome affects several lower spinal nerve roots, commonly through compression.

text.zh-CN: 马尾是脊髓下端向下延伸的一束神经根，负责双腿和盆腔器官的信息传递。受损后可同时影响感觉、力量和排泄控制，因此疼痛并不能代表全部严重程度。
text.en: The cauda equina is a bundle of nerve roots continuing below the spinal cord, carrying messages for the legs and pelvic organs. Damage can affect sensation, strength and bladder or bowel control, so pain alone does not show its full severity.

text.zh-CN: 椎间盘组织突出可占据神经原有的空间；椎管狭窄使可用空间进一步变小。肿块、感染或骨折也可能压迫神经，因此医生需要确定病因，而不是把所有病例当成同一种腰椎间盘病。
text.en: A herniated disc can occupy space normally available to the nerves; spinal stenosis narrows that space further. A mass, infection or fracture can also compress nerves, so clinicians establish the cause rather than treat every case as the same disc problem.

text.zh-CN: 神经检查会了解腿部力量、感觉和反射，并询问发病经过及膀胱肠道变化。MRI 观察神经周围空间及压迫部位；影像必须与症状一起解释。
text.en: Assessment reviews leg strength, sensation and reflexes alongside symptom onset and bladder or bowel changes. MRI shows the space around the nerves and sites of compression; imaging is interpreted with symptoms.

text.en: Bladder ultrasound can measure urine before and after voiding to assess emptying. An abnormal residual volume has several possible causes and does not by itself diagnose CES.

text.zh-CN: 症状与其他神经问题可相似；检查是为了确定病变部位和是否有压迫。
text.en: Symptoms can resemble other nerve disorders; assessment locates the problem and establishes whether compression is present.

text.zh-CN: 普通腰腿痛、局部神经根受压和马尾综合征可有重叠症状。新出现的膀胱肠道、鞍区感觉或进行性力量变化，使评估重点从缓解疼痛转向排除神经急症。
text.en: Ordinary back or leg pain and individual nerve-root problems can overlap with CES. New bladder/bowel, saddle-sensation or progressive strength changes shift assessment toward excluding a neurological emergency.

text.zh-CN: 即使排除了急性马尾压迫，仍可能需要寻找其他脊柱、神经或腹盆腔问题。不同部位的问题不能仅靠痛的位置自行区分。
text.en: Even after acute cauda equina compression is excluded, other spinal, nerve or abdominal/pelvic causes may need investigation. Pain location alone cannot reliably distinguish these pathways.

text.zh-CN: 腰骶神经丛病变发生在神经离开脊柱后汇成的网络，也可造成腿部疼痛、无力或感觉改变；马尾病变的位置则在椎管内。医生结合感觉和力量的分布与影像定位，不能仅凭“腿麻”确定是哪一种。
text.en: Lumbosacral plexus disorders affect a nerve network after the nerves leave the spine and can also cause leg pain, weakness or sensory change; the cauda equina lies within the spinal canal. Clinicians use the pattern of sensory and strength changes with imaging to localize the problem; leg numbness alone does not identify which disorder is present.

text.en: Bowel medicines have different roles: stool softeners soften stool, while stimulant laxatives such as senna or bisacodyl encourage bowel movement. The team plans treatment around stool consistency, difficulty emptying and leakage; one drug is not suitable for every bowel problem.

text.zh-CN: 长期疼痛和麻木可影响睡眠与活动，失禁及性功能改变可带来情绪和关系压力。身体治疗与心理、社会支持需要一起安排，不能只看手术是否完成。
